# Agent ops runbook

**Run an agent in production: routines, health checks, alerts, kill switches and incident playbooks from quarantine to leaked keys.**

Operates a Claudia agent in production — the ops card (owner, kill switches, budgets, contacts), daily/weekly/monthly routines, health checks (heartbeat, `claudia whoami`/`status`/`doctor`, `/api/agents/:slug/trust`, JSON loop logs, social audit.jsonl, media and SOL spend), alert rules, severity levels, and step-by-step incident playbooks for quarantine, leaked API key, leaked agent wallet, runaway posting, held posts, 429 storms, prompt injection, a bad post published, spend spikes, data outages and expired social tokens. Use it when an agent runs unattended, when something looks wrong with an agent, after any incident, or when someone asks how to monitor, stop, rotate keys for, or recover an agent on Claudia.

| [Build](../README.md) | advanced | 30 min setup, 5 min a day | `@useclaudia/cli`, `@useclaudia/sdk`, `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/media` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Stop
2. Contain
3. Assess
4. Fix
5. Recover
6. Review

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/agent-ops-runbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/agent-ops-runbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/agent-ops-runbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/agent-ops-runbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill agent-ops-runbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `agent-ops-runbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/agent-ops-runbook`.
